full_prompt_en: A square high-contrast black-and-white street photograph shows three figures moving through a burst of backlit spray on a wet path. The nearest person stands slightly left of center in a dark knee-length garment, turned partly toward two lighter figures farther away. One middle figure steps forward through the bright mist, while another appears behind and to the right, both partly obscured by water droplets and glare. Their exact facial features and clothing details disappear in the heavy contrast; posture and placement carry the moment. The path rises gently into the luminous center and is slick with broken reflections. Along the lower edge, irregular dark patches of pavement and a long, sharply stretched shadow lead toward the viewer. Dense black foliage or a dark wall frames the left side, and another dark mass closes the right edge. From above and behind, a hard white light catches the spray, turning it into a textured curtain of sparkling dots and pale vapor. The brightest region blooms around the distant figures, while the foreground person remains almost a silhouette. Grain, motion softness and blown highlights are visible rather than corrected away, adding urgency to the scene. The image contains no readable text and little conventional background detail beyond the path and dark edges. The overall composition pulls a narrow procession from shadow into a white burst, using extreme tonal contrast and reflected light to make an ordinary passing moment feel cinematic and fleeting.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形高反差黑白街头照片呈现三个人穿过湿路上逆光照亮的水雾。最近的人位于中央稍左，穿深色及膝衣服，身体部分转向更远处两名较浅的人影。中间一人踏进明亮雾气，另一人出现在后方偏右，两人都被水滴与眩光部分遮住。面部五官和服饰细节在强对比中消失，姿态与位置承担这一瞬间的内容。道路向发亮的中央微微上升，表面湿滑，倒影破碎。下缘处，不规则深色路面斑块和一道拉长、清晰的影子指向观者。浓黑树叶或深墙框住左侧，另一块暗形封住右缘。硬白光从上方和后方照来，抓住飞溅水雾，将其化作闪光点与浅色蒸汽组成的纹理帘幕。最亮区域在远处人物周围泛白，前景人物则近乎剪影。颗粒、运动柔化和过曝高光都清晰保留，为场景增加急迫感。画面没有可读文字，除道路和深暗两侧外几乎没有常规背景细节。整体构图把一列狭窄的人影从阴影牵向白光爆发，借极端明暗对比和反射光让寻常经过变得有电影感且稍纵即逝。
style_prompt_en: A gritty monochrome street-photography treatment pushes black and white toward their extremes, preserving only a narrow range of textured midtones. Hard backlight blooms into pale haze and catches countless small reflective particles, while dense edge shadows reduce surrounding forms to silhouettes. Wet or glossy surfaces fracture the light into irregular bright patches and long dark streaks. Grain and slight motion blur remain visible, making the moment feel immediate rather than clinically sharp. Strong diagonals and converging dark margins funnel attention toward a luminous center. The composition relies on shadow, glare and fleeting movement to create drama, with little need for color or detailed setting.
style_prompt_zh: 粗粝的黑白街头摄影处理把黑与白推向极端，只留下狭窄且有纹理的中间调。硬逆光在浅雾中泛白，并抓住无数细小反光颗粒；浓重边缘阴影则把周围形体压成剪影。潮湿或光亮表面把光打碎成不规则亮斑与长深色线。颗粒与轻微运动模糊保留下来，让瞬间显得即时，而非临床般锐利。强斜线与汇聚的暗色边缘把注意力导向明亮中心。构图依靠阴影、眩光与短暂运动建立戏剧性，几乎不需要色彩或细密环境。
